1788.s: Between the two supports of the dolmen, stretched on the sacrificial table and clad in a spotless gown that came down to her feet, lay the Druidess.

You have remembered my directions very well, the slings of your sword ought to be longer, loosen the buckles a little, and tighten the straps of the dolmen, now the fur cap; it is lucky you can take it off for dancing, it is quite too hot to wear, but you must keep it on till you begin to dance."
